notes.title: Jitsumi Game Booster 2.0: A Major Upgrade for Enhanced Gaming Experience
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GOcLnb4AsxI;full][/previewyoutube]

The wait is finally over! Jitsumi Game Booster is proud to announce the major update of our software, featuring a complete recode and reworking of the entire system. We have listened to our users and have made significant improvements to provide you with an exceptional gaming experience.

Here's what's new:
[olist]
[*] A brand new UI that is modern, sleek and user-friendly
[*] An updated performance monitor that tracks all your CPU cores, overall performance, RAM and GPU usage, and GPU temperatures
[*] A brand new NVIDIA tab that allows you to tweak and change every NVIDIA setting with ease
[*] A better game detection system to ensure you never miss a beat
[*] Almost all bugs fixed for a smooth and uninterrupted gaming experience
[*] A brand new config tab that allows you to whitelist and blacklist programs
[*] All settings are now saved whenever you restart the program
[*] The window tab has been reworked for a more efficient experience
[*] Cleaning and defragging of drives improved and less prone to bugs
[/olist]

Get ready to take control of your gaming system and unleash its full potential with Jitsumi Game Booster 2.0. Download now and experience the difference!

notes.title: Change Log: 6/3 ( Minor )
notes.content:
[b]Change Logs:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added Changelog Tab:[/b]
- We added a new tab which allows you to view our progress and change logs instead of visiting the steam website to do so

[*] [b]Fixed Set Game Crashes:[/b]
- This fixes some crashes that occur when setting curtain programs to the game

[*] [b]Fix on exit Crashes:[/b]
- This fixes crashes which occurred when viewing the Custom tab and exiting the program

[*] [b]Fix Game Crashes[/b]
- This fixes some game crashes that occur due to the free unused memory option

[*] [b]Limited Game Name[/b]
- This limits the displayed game name, as some game names were going offscreen
[/list]

If you have any ideas or suggestions, please don't hesitate to post it in https://steamcommunity.com/app/1014130/discussions/2/1648791520830059558/

notes.title: Change Log: 5/26 ( Major )
notes.content:
[b]Change Logs:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Custom Tab:[/b]
- This is a whole new extra tab which will be in the console tab. This tab allows you to set games from a list of visible windows. There are other extra options which also allows you to set the window as borderless, windowed and change it's priority.

[*] [b]Seperation of Load & Specs:[/b]
- This basically creates 2 new tabs labled Spec and Load. Load displays the usual PC's CPU, GPU and RAM load in a percentage bar. Spec allows you to view some of your PC's specification.

[*] [b]Fixed Some Major Bugs:[/b]
- This fixes a few major bugs which had been causing crashes for some users. If you still are sometimes crashing, please make a post in our steam discussion so that we can take actions

[*] [b]Added Back Motherboard:[/b]
- Added back motherboard which can be seen in the Spec tab
[/list]

If you have any ideas or suggestions, please don't hesitate to post it in https://steamcommunity.com/app/1014130/discussions/2/1648791520830059558/

notes.title: Change Log: 5/20 ( Major )
notes.content:
[b]Change Logs:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added Help Markers[/b]
- Added help markers beside the functions which are used the most to provide assistance to new users who might not understand what the feature is used for

[*] [b]Added Config Manager For Automation[/b]
- We received alot of feedback about how it was extremely annoying to setup the automation section after every launch. We now have a config loader which allows you to save the settings and load it on demand or on launch

[*] [b]Added Support For 3 Other DRMs[/b]
- Uplay
- Epic Games
- Origin

( Please Make sure to use the default installation directory when installing games from those DRMs. We are also planning on adding custom games where you can add a game which may not belong to those DRMs )

[*] [b]Fixed Some Major Bugs[/b]
- We fixed some major bugs which might have caused the crashes that people were getting when loading into the program

[*] [b]Changed Error Messages[/b]
- We added afew more error messages and info messages which can help users understand afew more information about the error message / info messages. Info messages will now be displayed in GREEN and error messages will now be displayed in RED

[*] [b]Added BlackList Command[/b]
- We added a blacklist command which allows you to blacklist curtain programs which you may not want the booster to touch. Simply type to console, blacklist <program name. EG discord.exe>

[*] [b]Removed MotherBoard From the Specs List[/b]
- Some people had major crashes due to this, therefore we decided to remove it completely

[*] [b]On Launch Blue Light Filter[/b]
- You can now enable blue light to automatically turn on during launch. We received some feedback about the annoyance of turning on the blue light filter manually
[/list]

If you have any ideas or suggestions, please don't hesitate to post it in https://steamcommunity.com/app/1014130/discussions/2/1648791520830059558/

notes.title: Pre-Release and Beta Testers
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!
we are so excited to finally have a chance to move into the Steam platform!

We are also currently looking for beta testers who are willing to help us improve our program.

What we need you to do:
- Check for any buggy features
- Memory leaks
- Any crashes and provide us with crash dumps
- Providing any suggestions for the software

Offer:
- Providing you with a steam key which allows you to use the program before the release date.

Requirements:
- Having a PC which meets the minimum requirements for the program
- Intel CPU / Nvidia GPU

To enlist, please just reply in this thread
Thank you!
